devdoc.author: GET Protocol DAOUses Maple's RevenueDistributionToken v1.0.1 under AGPL-3.0 (https://github.com/maple-labs/revenue-distribution-token/tree/v1.0.1)Uses OpenZeppelin's ERC20Votes and ERC20VotesComp v4.8.0-rc.1 under MIT (https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts/tree/v4.8.0-rc.1/)
devdoc.details: Voting power applies to the the total asset balance, including assets reserved for withdrawal.Limited to a maximum asset supply of uint96.

acceptOwnership().details: Sets the pending owner as the new owner.       Can be called only by the pending owner, and only after their nomination by the current owner.

approve(address,uint256).details: Function that allows one account to set the allowance of another account over their tokens.          Emits an {Approval} event.

params.amount_: Amount of tokens that have been approved.
params.spender_: Account that tokens are approved for.

returns.success_: Boolean indicating whether the operation succeeded.

balanceOfAssets(address).details: Returns the amount of underlying assets owned by the specified account.

params.pos_: Index/position of the withdrawal request to be cancelled.

checkpoints(address,uint32).details: Maintains Compound `checkpoints` compatibility by returning votes as a uint96 and omitting shares.

returns.fromBlock_: Block in which the checkpoint is valid from.
returns.votes_: Total amount of underlying assets (votes) derived from shares.

convertToAssets(uint256).details: The amount of `assets_` the `shares_` are currently equivalent to.          MUST NOT be inclusive of any fees that are charged against assets in the Vault.          MUST NOT reflect slippage or other on-chain conditions when performing the actual exchange.          MUST NOT show any variations depending on the caller.          MUST NOT revert.

params.shares_: The amount of shares to convert.

params.blockNumber_: Block to use for checkpoint lookup.
params.shares_: Amount of shares to conver to assets.

returns.assets_: Amount of assets held at block, representing voting power.

convertToShares(uint256).details: The amount of `shares_` the `assets_` are currently equivalent to.          MUST NOT be inclusive of any fees that are charged against assets in the Vault.          MUST NOT reflect slippage or other on-chain conditions when performing the actual exchange.          MUST NOT show any variations depending on the caller.          MUST NOT revert.

params.assets_: The amount of assets to convert.

params.shares_: Amount of shares to redeem upon unlock.

decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Function that allows one account to decrease the allowance of another account over their tokens.          Emits an {Approval} event.

params.spender_: Account that tokens are approved for.

returns.success_: Boolean indicating whether the operation succeeded.

delegate(address).details: Shares are delegated upon mint and transfer and removed upon burn.

delegateBySig(address,uint256,uint256,ui.details: Equivalent to the OpenZeppelin implementation but written in style of ERC20.permit.

params.deadline_: Deadline after which the permit is invalid.
params.nonce_: Nonce of next signature transaction, expected to be equal to `nonces(signer)`.

deposit(uint256,address).details: Mints `shares_` to `receiver_` by depositing `assets_` into the Vault.          MUST emit the {Deposit} event.          MUST revert if all of the assets cannot be deposited (due to insufficient approval, deposit limits, slippage, etc).

params.assets_: The amount of assets to deposit.

deposit(uint256,address,uint256).details: Reentrancy modifier provided within the internal function call.

params.minShares_: Minimum amount of shares to be returned.

returns.shares_: Amount of shares returned to receiver_.

depositWithPermit(uint256,address,uint25.details: Does a ERC4626 `deposit` with a ERC-2612 `permit`.

params.deadline_: The timestamp after which the `permit` signature is no longer valid.

params.pos_: Index/position of the withdrawal request to be executed.

params.account_: Address of account to get votes for.

returns.votes_: Amount of voting power as the number of assets for delegated shares.

params.blockNumber_: Block number to check for total supply.

params.account_: Address of account to get votes for.

returns.votes_: Amount of voting power as the number of assets for delegated shares.

params.account_: Address of account to get votes for.

returns.votes_: Amount of voting power as the number of assets for delegated shares.

getVotes(address).details: The delegated balance is denominated in the amount of shares delegated to an account, but voting power is measured in assets. A conversion is done using the delegated shares to get the assets as of the latest checkpoint. This ensures that all stakers' shares are converted to assets at the same rate.

params.account_: Address of account to get votes for.

returns.votes_: Amount of voting power as the number of assets for delegated shares.

increaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: Function that allows one account to increase the allowance of another account over their tokens.          Emits an {Approval} event.

params.spender_: Account that tokens are approved for.

returns.success_: Boolean indicating whether the operation succeeded.

maxDeposit(address).details: Restricted to uint96 as defined in WithdrawalRequest struct.

returns.maxAssets_: The maximum amount of assets that can be deposited.

maxMint(address).details: Restricted to uint96 as defined in WithdrawalRequest struct.

returns.maxShares_: The maximum amount of shares that can be minted.

maxRedeem(address).details: Maximum amount of `shares_` that can be redeemed from the `owner_` through a `redeem` call.          MUST return a limited value if the owner is subject to any limits, or the total amount of owned shares otherwise.          MUST NOT revert.

returns.maxShares_: The maximum amount of shares that can be redeemed.

maxWithdraw(address).details: Maximum amount of `assets_` that can be withdrawn from the `owner_` through a `withdraw` call.          MUST return a limited value if the owner is subject to any limits, or the total amount of owned assets otherwise.          MUST NOT revert.

returns.maxAssets_: The maximum amount of assets that can be withdrawn.

mint(uint256,address).details: Mints `shares_` to `receiver_` by depositing `assets_` into the Vault.          MUST emit the {Deposit} event.          MUST revert if all of shares cannot be minted (due to insufficient approval, deposit limits, slippage, etc).

params.shares_: The amount of shares to mint.

mint(uint256,address,uint256).details: Reentrancy modifier provided within the internal function call.

params.maxAssets_: Maximum amount of assets to be deducted.

returns.assets_: Amount of deducted when minting shares.

mintWithPermit(uint256,address,uint256,u.details: Does a ERC4626 `mint` with a ERC-2612 `permit`.

params.deadline_: The timestamp after which the `permit` signature is no longer valid.
params.maxAssets_: The maximum amount of assets that can be taken, as per the permit.

params.deadline_: Deadline after which the permit is invalid.
params.owner_: Owner address that signed the permit.

previewDeposit(uint256).details: Allows an on-chain or off-chain user to simulate the effects of their deposit at the current block, given current on-chain conditions.          MUST return as close to and no more than the exact amount of shares that would be minted in a `deposit` call in the same transaction.          MUST NOT account for deposit limits like those returned from `maxDeposit` and should always act as though the deposit would be accepted.          MUST NOT revert.

params.assets_: The amount of assets to deposit.

returns.shares_: The amount of shares that would be minted.

previewMint(uint256).details: Allows an on-chain or off-chain user to simulate the effects of their mint at the current block, given current on-chain conditions.          MUST return as close to and no fewer than the exact amount of assets that would be deposited in a `mint` call in the same transaction.          MUST NOT account for mint limits like those returned from `maxMint` and should always act as though the minting would be accepted.          MUST NOT revert.

params.shares_: The amount of shares to mint.

returns.assets_: The amount of assets that would be deposited.

previewRedeem(uint256).details: Returns the amount of redeemable assets for given shares after instant withdrawal fee.`address(0)` cannot be set as exempt, and is used here as default to imply that fees must be deducted.

params.shares_: The amount of shares to redeem.

returns.assets_: The amount of assets that would be withdrawn.
Assets redeemed for shares for owner.

previewWithdraw(uint256).details: Returns the amount of redeemable assets for given shares after instant withdrawal fee.`address(0)` cannot be set as exempt, and is used here as default to imply that fees must be deducted.

params.assets_: The amount of assets to withdraw.

returns.shares_: The amount of shares that would be redeemed.
Shares needed to be burned for owner.

params.pos_: Index/position of the withdrawal request to be previewed.

returns.assets_: Amount of assets returned to owner if withdrawn.

redeem(uint256,address,address).details: Will check for withdrawal fee exemption present on owner.

params.shares_: The amount of shares to redeem.

returns.assets_: The amount of assets sent to the receiver.

redeem(uint256,address,address,uint256).details: Reentrancy modifier provided within the internal function call.

params.minAssets_: Minimum amount of assets to be returned.

params.percentage_: Fee percentage. Must be an integer between 0 and 100 inclusive.

params.lockTime_: Length of lock of a standard withdrawal request.

setPendingOwner(address).details: Sets a new address as the pending owner.

params.pendingOwner_: The address of the next potential owner.

setWithdrawalFeeExemption(address,bool).details: The zero address cannot be set as exmempt as this will always represent an address that pays fees.

params.owner_: Owner address to exempt from instant withdrawal fees.
params.status_: true to add exemption, false to remove exemption.

totalAssets().details: Total amount of the underlying asset that is managed by the Vault.          SHOULD include compounding that occurs from any yields.          MUST NOT revert.

returns.totalManagedAssets_: The total amount of assets the Vault manages.

transfer(address,uint256).details: Moves an amount of tokens from `msg.sender` to a specified account.          Emits a {Transfer} event.

params.amount_: Amount of tokens that are transferred.

returns.success_: Boolean indicating whether the operation succeeded.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Moves a pre-approved amount of tokens from a sender to a specified account.          Emits a {Transfer} event.          Emits an {Approval} event.

params.amount_: Amount of tokens that are transferred.
params.owner_: Account that tokens are moving from.

returns.success_: Boolean indicating whether the operation succeeded.

updateVestingSchedule().details: Identical to parent implementation but made public by fixed vesting period and removal of owner check.

returns.freeAssets_: Amount of assets currently released to stakers.
returns.issuanceRate_: Slope of release of newly added assets, scaled up by `precision`.

updateVestingSchedule(uint256).details: Updates the current vesting formula based on the amount of total unvested funds in the contract and the new `vestingPeriod_`.

params.vestingPeriod_: The amount of time over which all currently unaccounted underlying assets will be vested over.

returns.freeAssets_: The new amount of underlying assets that are unlocked.

withdraw(uint256,address,address).details: Will check for withdrawal fee exemption present on owner.

params.assets_: The amount of assets to withdraw.

returns.shares_: The amount of shares burned from the owner.

withdraw(uint256,address,address,uint256.details: Reentrancy modifier provided within the internal function call.

params.maxShares_: Minimum amount of shares to be deducted.

params.owner_: Account address of owner of withdrawal requests.

returns.count_: Number of withdrawal request created for owner account.

params.owner_: Account address of owner of withdrawal requests.

returns.withdrawalRequests_: Array of withdrawal request structs for an owner.

params.pos_: Index/position of the withdrawal request in the array.

returns.withdrawalRequest_: Withdrawal request struct found at position for owner.

userCheckpoints.details: Unused in Compound governance specification, exposes underlying Checkpoint struct.

returns.assets: Total amount of underlying assets derived from shares at time of checkpoint.
returns.fromBlock: Block in which the checkpoint is valid from.
returns.shares: Total amount of shares within the checkpoint.

devdoc.title: ERC-4626 revenue distribution vault with locking and Compound-compatible governance.

CancellationBurn(uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when burning shares upon withdrawal request cancellation.

DelegateChanged(address,address,address).notice: Emitted when an account changes their delegate.

DelegateVotesChanged(address,uint256,uin.notice: Emitted when a token transfer or delegate change results in changes to a delegate's number of votes.

InstantWithdrawalFeeChanged(uint256).notice: Emitted when the instant withdrawal fee is set.

LockTimeChanged(uint256).notice: Emitted when time-to-unlock for a standard withdrawal set.

Redistribute(uint256).notice: Emitted when redistributing rewards upon early execution or cancellation of a withdrawal request.

Refund(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when refunding shares upon withdrawal request cancellation.

WithdrawalFeeExemptionStatusChanged(addr.notice: Emitted when fee exemption status has been set for an address.

WithdrawalFeePaid(address,address,addres.notice: Emitted when an instant withdrawal fee is paid.

WithdrawalRequestCancelled(uint256).notice: Emitted when an account cancels any existing withdrawal requests.

WithdrawalRequestCreated((uint32,uint32,.notice: Emitted when a new withdrawal request has been created for an account.

WithdrawalRequestExecuted(uint256).notice: Emitted when a withdrawal request has been executed with shares burned and assets withdrawn.

MAXIMUM_LOCK_TIME().notice: Constant maximum lock time able to be set using `setLockTime` to avoid permanent lockup.

WITHDRAWAL_WINDOW().notice: Constant time window in which unlocked withdrawal requests can be executed.

cancelWithdrawalRequest(uint256).notice: Removes an open withdrawal request for the sender.

convertToAssets(uint256,uint256).notice: Historical conversion from shares to assets, used for calculating voting power on past blocks.

createWithdrawalRequest(uint256).notice: Creates a new withdrawal request for future execution using the shares conversion at the point of request. May only be executed after the unlock date.Transfers shares to the vault contract to reserve them, reducing share balance.

delegate(address).notice: Delegates votes from the sender to `delegatee`.

deposit(uint256,address,uint256).notice: ERC5143 slippage-protected deposit method. The transaction will revert if the shares to be returned is less than minShares_.

executeWithdrawalRequest(uint256).notice: Executes an existing withdrawal request for msg.sender. Before the request is unlocked, a percentage fee will be paid, equal to a percentage of the instantWithdrawalFee by time elapsed of the request.

getCurrentVotes(address).notice: Comp version of the `getVotes` accessor, with `uint96` return type.

getPastTotalSupply(uint256).notice: Returns the total supply of shares available at the end of a past block (`blockNumber`).

getPastVotes(address,uint256).notice: Returns the amount of votes that `account` had at the end of a past block (`blockNumber`).

getPriorVotes(address,uint256).notice: Comp version of the `getPastVotes` accessor, with `uint96` return type.

getVotes(address).notice: Returns the current amount of votes that `account` has.

instantWithdrawalFee().notice: Percentage withdrawal fee to be applied to instant withdrawals.

lockTime().notice: The lock time set for standard withdrawals to become unlocked.

mint(uint256,address,uint256).notice: ERC5143 slippage-protected mint method. The transaction will revert if the assets to be deducted is greater than maxAssets_.

previewRedeem(uint256,address).notice: Previews a redemption of shares for owner. Applies withdrawal fee if owner does not have an exemption.

previewWithdraw(uint256,address).notice: Previews a withdrawal of assets for owner. Applies withdrawal fee if owner does not have an exemption.

previewWithdrawalRequest(uint256,address.notice: Previews a withdrawal request execution, calculating the assets returned to the receiver and fee paid.Fee percentage reduces linearly from instantWithdrawalFee until 0 at the unlockedAt timestamp.

redeem(uint256,address,address,uint256).notice: ERC5143 slippage-protected redeem method. The transaction will revert if the assets to be returned is less than minAssets_.

setInstantWithdrawalFee(uint256).notice: Sets the intstant withdrawal fee, applied when making instant withdrawals or redemptions.Can only be set by owner.

setLockTime(uint256).notice: Sets the lock time for standard withdrawals to become unlocked.Can only be set by owner.Must be lower than MAXIMUM_LOCK_TIME to prevent permanent lockup.

setWithdrawalFeeExemption(address,bool).notice: Sets or unsets an owner address to be exempt from the withdrawal fee.Useful in case of future migrations where an approved contract may be given permission to migrate balances to a new token. Can also be used to exempt third-party vaults from facing withdrawal fee when managing balances, such as lending platform liquidations.Can only be set by contract `owner`.

updateVestingSchedule().notice: Executes an existing withdrawal request that has passed its unlock date.

withdraw(uint256,address,address,uint256.notice: ERC5143 slippage-protected withdraw method. The transaction will revert if the shares to be deducted is greater than maxShares_.

withdrawalFeeExemptions(address).notice: Returns exemption status for a given account. When true then instant withdrawal fee will not apply.

withdrawalRequestCount(address).notice: Returns a count of the number of created withdrawal requests for an account, including cancelled.

withdrawalRequests(address).notice: Returns an array of created withdrawal requests for an account, including cancelled.

withdrawalRequests(address,uint256).notice: Returns existing withdrawal request for a given account.

userdoc.notice: Tokens are locked and must be subject to time-based or fee-based withdrawal conditions.
